g.text: Panels g–h from the previous layout are removed; the retained analyses are numbered consecutively a–d.

g.text: a, One prespecified outer fold's 16 held-out trials are averaged to display observed and archived-factor reconstructed rates for all 603 strict-QC clusters with one ordering and the shared linear −2 to +4 z-score scale. b, Complete-trial out-of-fold

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: firing-rate R² is reported for every cluster; the violin display is limited to −1 to 1 while full values remain in source data. c, CASTLE phase decoding uses balanced accuracy because phase is categorical. d, Each regional and all-area decoder is

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: retrained after retaining random-k, training-ranked top-k or bottom-k units; regularization selected on the full training population is reused across subset sizes. Rankings are predictive rather than causal, and folds are repeated splits of one mouse-day.
